one_line: Chahamana king of early 12th-century Ajayameru (Ajmer), builder of a hill capital and defender of Rajasthan against Ghaznavid and Paramara attacks.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early 40s, athletic and broad-shouldered with a disciplined warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp jawline, medium wheat complexion typical of central Rajasthan, straight nose, thick brows, a short neatly kept moustache, and calm, observant eyes; default expression is composed and confident, with a faint strategic half-smile.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a low knot at the back of the head, partly covered by a conical Rajput-style cloth turban in deep maroon with a narrow mustard band and a small central metal kalgi-like finial, no extravagant plume.
appearance.costume: Over a long-sleeved off-white cotton angarkha-style tunic that wraps right over left and falls to just below the knees, he wears a fitted sleeveless mail-and-plate vest rendered as small overlapping iron-gray plates over fine chain; around his waist is a wide dark indigo cotton patka sash with subtle block-printed floral motifs in dull gold, knotted at his left hip with one short end hanging to mid-thigh; his lower garment is a pair of straight, slightly loose churidar-like trousers in muted sand-brown tucked into sturdy mid-calf leather boots dyed dark brown; over one shoulder is a light ochre woollen shawl-cloak edged with a simple red border, draped from his left shoulder across his back and pinned near the right collarbone, hinting at the cooler Aravalli foothills; he wears minimal jewellery—one plain gold armlet on his right arm, a single narrow gold bangle on the left wrist, and small round gold stud earrings—signifying royal status without ostentation.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved one-edged early Rajput sword (proto-talwar) with an iron-gray blade, a simple disc pommel, gently flared cross-guard, and a dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, carried in a plain brown leather scabbard with modest brass fittings and suspended from a belt over his patka.

ref_desc: Ajayaraja II is a mid-30s Rajput king with a wheat complexion, neat moustache, black hair in a low knot under a deep maroon turban, wearing an off-white angarkha, iron-gray mail vest, indigo patka, sand-brown trousers, dark brown boots, ochre shawl, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a curved proto-talwar in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Ajayaraja II, a mid-30s Rajput king with an athletic build, wheat complexion, oval face, sharp jawline, thick brows, straight nose, and a short neatly kept moustache, his default expression composed and confident with a faint strategic half-smile. His thick black hair is tied in a low knot at the back and partly covered by a conical deep maroon cloth turban with a narrow mustard band and a small central metal finial. He wears a long-sleeved off-white cotton angarkha-style tunic wrapping right over left to just below the knees, over which sits a sleeveless iron-gray mail-and-plate vest of small overlapping plates. A wide dark indigo cotton patka with subtle dull-gold floral block prints girds his waist, knotted at the left hip, with one short end hanging, and straight slightly loose sand-brown trousers tuck into sturdy mid-calf dark brown leather boots. A light ochre woollen shawl with a simple red border is draped from his left shoulder across his back and pinned near the right collarbone, suggesting the Aravalli hill climate. His jewellery is minimal: a plain gold armlet on the right arm, a narrow gold bangle on the left wrist, and small round gold stud earrings. At his left side hangs his signature weapon, a slightly curved one-edged proto-talwar with an iron-gray blade, simple disc pommel, flared cross-guard, and dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, sheathed in a plain brown leather scabbard with modest brass fittings. Use a palette dominated by deep maroon, indigo blue, off-white, sand brown, and iron gray, and present him in a neutral stance with front, side, and back views to emphasise consistent face, hair, clothing, and sword details.
